data.long_meaning: Aatik is an Arabic name meaning “Free; liberated; (also) of ancient vintage”. ʿ-t-q — ʿātiq; cf. ʿatīq 'ancient, freed'.
data.spiritual_meaning: Any spiritual reading placed on Aatik is interpretive and is labelled as such; the documented core is the lexical meaning “Free; liberated; (also) of ancient vintage”.

data.hidden_personality_traits: Not objectively established. No empirical basis exists for hidden or subconscious traits from a name. Any such reading is interpretive tradition, not a fact about the person.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aatik total 6, reducing to 6. The number 6 is associated with care and responsibility. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.
